scope: P6 near-limit local Web documents, repeated reload, cross-plugin replacement, and close-time helper/object reclamation on an isolated macOS Release app

system.name: macOS
system.display: one online 2560 x 1440 display in a 5120 x 2880 backing mode

dev.example.text-pad.functional_caveat: the page and large editor rendered, but the bridge displayed INACTIVE in this run

text_pad.editor_limit_materialized: host text bridge limit is 1 MiB; this fixture measured editor/WebKit cost, not a 1 MiB Host text transfer

large_json_open.observed: 1,046,501 bytes entered; automatic formatting and JavaScript evaluation produced 227,502 bytes from 45,501 JSON nodes

reload_matrix.result: pass after the production lifetime fix
reload_matrix.first_failed_attempt: before the lifetime fix, closeCurrent ran before rebind and removed the whole invocation; the UI showed the tool as unavailable on every reload
reload_matrix.fix: WebDocumentLifetime.openAndAccept binds the next epoch first, then closes the prior document; a stale generation closes a late binding without replacing the current one

after_five_reloads_blank.interpretation: one blank Web document remains open; WebContent and GPU retain process high-water memory after the large documents

cross_plugin.json_to_text_pad: pass for closing JSON Workspace, preserving the search scope, and mounting Text Pad; the Text Pad bridge displayed INACTIVE while its DOM editor still accepted the near-1 MiB fixture

physical_footprint_mib.note: heap sampling preceded these footprint values and can perturb them

sdk_startup_fix.problem: a caller that subscribed immediately after definePlugin could emit state.subscribe concurrently with lifecycle.ready
sdk_startup_fix.change: definePlugin registers early subscriptions synchronously but binds them only after ready succeeds; hidden registration still throws INACTIVE
sdk_startup_fix.tests: plugin SDK 51 passed, including early-subscription ordering and hidden-registration rejection
sdk_startup_fix.gui_retest: pending because macOS locked during the final package update; source and package tests passed, but this is not counted as a completed WebKit functional retest

limitations: RSS and Physical footprint are separate accounting systems; helper RSS is not added to main footprint as an exact application total.

The JSON fixture is local, ASCII, single-document, and within the hard 1 MiB/50k-node budgets; large Unicode, nested trees, multiple simultaneous WebViews, remote resources, and network failure are not covered.
Heap sampling perturbs later footprint samples; high-water values are not a leak proof or a pre/post optimization percentage.
WebContent memory rises sharply for a near-limit JSON document, showing that Host transfer limits do not cap WebKit parser, text editor, DOM, formatting, and JavaScript-engine copies.
The Text Pad bridge displayed INACTIVE while its DOM editor remained usable. The SDK startup-order fix was built and unit-tested after this run but still needs a final packaged App/WebKit retest.
Only one 2560 x 1440 display was attached, so multi-display and display-scale transitions were not exercised.
